config.description: ew_benchmark's universe and cadence exactly (top 50 by RS, monthly), weighted proportional to 1/sigma over 60 daily log returns instead of equally. Names with <40 bars or zero measured vol are EXCLUDED, never guessed; single-name weight is capped at 3x equal weight and the book renormalised.
config.expectation: Lower drawdown and lower volatility than ew_benchmark at a small CAGR toll, because the screen's worst drawdowns are driven by its highest-vol names. The honest prior is that inverse-vol weighting mostly re-expresses a low-vol tilt, and low_vol already trails EW by -19.95% mean excess.
config.kill_criterion: Fails to reduce max drawdown vs ew_benchmark across a full risk-off fold, or trails ew_benchmark by >10% cumulative over 12 months without a lower max drawdown.
config.name: EW Screen — Inverse-Vol Weighted
